🔨 Live Auctions

Real items, live bidding — the full live-selling setup. List an item with photos and details, run it as a live auction or pin it at a Buy Now price, and the winner checks out with Stripe. Auctions run in the online room you're in — you can build your listings any time, then start them once you're connected.

📜 Auction rules — the honest version

  • Sellers ship the item to the winner after payment clears — the Plaza never holds or ships items.
  • All auction sales are final. No returns, no refunds — bid only on items you truly want.
  • No counterfeits, ever. List only genuine items you own and can ship. Fakes get your selling privileges pulled.
  • 18+ only — listing and bidding are adults-only, like the rest of the party.
  • Bids go up in steps that grow with the price — $1 under $10, then $2, $4, $5, $10, $20 (at $250–$999) and $25 as the price climbs. A bid in the last 5 seconds adds 5 seconds, so nobody gets sniped at the buzzer — unless the seller switched on Sudden Death, where the clock never extends and the last bid standing when it hits zero wins.
  • The winner pays the final bid plus the shipping on the listing (free shipping means $0). Buy Now items sell at the listed price plus their shipping.
  • The Plaza keeps a 10% cut of each auction sale (separate from the 30% gift cut) — sellers see both in their earnings.
